verdict.rationale: Grafana ships an official CLI (grafana-cli, [grafana-probe-5]) and a separate 'as-code'/observability-as-code CLI for authenticating, managing environments, and CI/CD tasks from the terminal ([grafana-docs-26], [grafana-docs-31]). However, evidence doesn't show these CLIs are framed or documented specifically for AI-native/agentic workflows (that role is filled instead by the separate MCP server). missing for 10: explicit documentation positioning the CLI for AI-agent-driven or natural-language usage, independent hands-on validation of CLI agentic use cases.
